title: Stop the Scroll: Design Stories That Stick
subtitle: Hooks get the click, structure keeps the watch
intro: Give me 9 minutes and I'll improve your story — but you only have 3 seconds to stop someone from scrolling. How do you earn the other 8 minutes and 57 seconds?
takeaway: A hook earns 3 seconds of attention, story structure earns the rest — never promise what you don't deliver.

sections.heading: Analogy: your story is a doorway
sections.body: Think of your Instagram Reel like a busy hallway. People walk past fast. A story hook is the open door that makes them stop and look inside. Story structure is the hallway inside — it guides them from start to finish without getting lost. Without that door and hallway, no one stays.

sections.heading: Why does this exist?: stop the scroll in 3 seconds
sections.body: You have 3 seconds before someone scrolls. That's why hooks exist. A hook is a first line that creates curiosity, like the 50 fill-in-the-blank templates that promise a quick win — "Give me 9 minutes and I'll improve your story." Audience engagement means they stay, watch, and comment. Good structure then delivers the promise step by step.

sections.heading: What can go wrong?: hooks without a story
sections.body: What breaks if you only chase hooks? You get views but no trust. If your 9-minute tip doesn't actually help, people leave and don't come back. Another trap: using the same loud hook 50 times. Your audience gets tired and scrolls anyway. Hooks must match the real story inside, or engagement drops fast.

steps.narration: Viewer is scrolling fast in a busy feed.
Your hook stops them in 3 seconds with curiosity.
Story structure guides them from start to finish.
They stay, watch, and engage if promise holds.
Deliver value and you earn trust, or you lose them.

quiz.q: What is a story hook in plain words?
options: The open door that makes someone stop scrolling in 3 seconds
The hashtags you add after posting
The camera you use to film
The time of day you post
quiz.why: A hook is the first line that creates curiosity and stops the scroll, like the 50 templates in your saves.

quiz.q: What fails first if you use hooks without good story structure?
options: You get views but people leave quickly and trust drops
Hooks stop working for everyone else
quiz.why: Hooks earn 3 seconds, but without structure that delivers the promise, engagement and trust break.

quiz.q: Why does the 'Give me 9 minutes' promise work only if you deliver?
options: Because audience engagement means staying only if the tip actually helps
Because Instagram pays you per minute
Because 9 minutes is the maximum Reel length
Because viewers cannot scroll after 9 minutes
quiz.why: Engagement is staying, watching, commenting — that only happens when structure delivers on the hook's promise.
